text:
incident-bot: ALERT — prod-east: sudden spike in 5xx for /api/* and /chat endpoints. p95 latency up, error-rate ~18% over last 6m. Paging #oncall (sre-oncall).

sre-oncall: on it, ack. any deploys or config rollouts around 00:45-00:50?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: config-rollout cfg-2026-03-15-0446 applied to proxy-pool-7 (proxy-pool-7/edge-proxy) at 00:46 UTC. No code changes.

Alex: seeing mostly 502 and 504 in gateway logs. sample: 
```
[2026-03-15T00:52:02Z] "POST /api/generate" 502 upstream reset, route=api-v1-gen cluster=svc-gen
[2026-03-15T00:52:10Z] "POST /chat" 504 upstream timeout, route=chat-broker
```

Carla: pulling envoy config from proxy-pool-7 now, matching config-rollout id. looks like a route matcher change: previously prefix "/api/" but new config requires prefix "/api/v1/" for api-v1-gen cluster and also added a path_rewrite that strips /api/v1.

Priya: that rewrite could make upstream see unexpected paths. also the rollout changed retry policy: 
```
retry_policy:
  retry_on: 5xx,gateway-error
  num_retries: 3
```
which will aggressively retry 5xx into more load.

reid: also glanced at cluster settings — circuit_breakers for svc-gen cluster have low max_connections and max_retries thresholds set (conservative values). combined with retries that's a feedback loop.

sre-oncall: hypothesis: route mismatch + rewrite routed some traffic to a pool / backend that doesn't expect the rewritten path -> upstream returns 502; retries magnify load; circuits open -> more 5xx. customer-facing impact spike.

cs-lead: customers ACorp and BetaApps reported errors in last 10m, CS triage opened. ETA to mitigate?

Alex: quick repro locally against proxy 10.2.x: curl -> returns 502 when path rewritten. shows upstream rejects due to missing header and unexpected path.

sre-oncall: action plan — 1) roll back the config-rollout to previous version 2) temporarily disable retries on gateway for the affected clusters to stop amplification 3) increase cluster circuit_breaker thresholds slightly to avoid immediate ejection while we stabilize 4) route traffic to shadow pool if needed. I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: rollback trigger: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo configmap/proxy-config --to-revision=2` started at 00:54 UTC.

Carla: setting retry policy to "never" for affected routes: applying hotpatch via admin API now.

sre-oncall: admin cmds: 
```
# disable retries for api-v1-gen and chat-broker clusters
curl -sS -X POST http://proxy-admin.prod-east.local/config_reload -d '{"patch": [{"op":"replace","path":"/clusters/svc-gen/retry_policy/num_retries","value":0}]}'
```

Priya: applied retry num_retries=0 for svc-gen and chat-broker at 00:55 UTC — confirmed no more retries in live logs.

Alex: rollback of configmap completed at 00:57 UTC, proxies picked up previous route matcher. I'm seeing a steady drop in 5xx. p95 latency dropping.

reid: bumped circuit_breaker max_connections and max_pending_requests on svc-gen cluster temporarily to allow in-flight drains.

incident-bot: Metrics: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 1.7% over 5 minutes post-rollback. p95 latency back to baseline ~300ms by 01:05 UTC.

cs-lead: notified ACorp and BetaApps that we mitigated and are investigating root cause.

sre-oncall: current status: partial mitigated, under observation. I'll keep the team updated. We should do a controlled canary of the config-change after fixing rewrite logic and adding integration tests for path_rewrite behavior.

Priya: filing follow-ups: 
- revert retry_on 5xx for gateway-level changes unless validated in staging 
- add unit/integration test for path_rewrite -> ensure upstream accepts rewritten path 
- add alert for sudden increase in retry count to detect amplification loops

Alex: logs & snippets saved to incident runbook, link: https://redwood-internal/incident/3276543210 (internal).

sre-oncall: final check: all proxies in pool healthy, no active 502 flood, leaving this thread open for 30m observation window. tagging postmortem owners: Priya and Alex.

reid: noted for postmortem — rollout gating: verify route matchers against live upstream health, and simulate retry amplification in canary.

Carla: thumbs up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: RESOLVED -> mitigated (rollback + retry disable) — monitoring. Will create Sev2 incident ticket and schedule postmortem.

sre-oncall: closing now, but will update when postmortem doc is ready. Thanks all for fast responses. :heart:
